mutations.name: AC-CONTRA
mutations._mechanism: skill-candidates (a): drop the transcript cross-check; a self-reported zero contradicted by 20+ parsed reads is mis-scored as a hollow pass again.

mutations.name: AC-CONTRA-FLOOR
mutations._mechanism: weaken the floor to >= ; a transcript AT the delivery floor (the report-file write alone) would then 'contradict' a genuinely hollow pass.

mutations.name: AC-CONTRA-WIRE
mutations._mechanism: connection removal: the report-file screen stops receiving the leg's log, so the cross-check can never run on the report-file path.
